_comment: §25 brand-icon corrections for the generated plugin catalog.
The generator auto-matches a plugin's name, then its repo owner, against the
real simple-icons slugs parsed out of node_modules/simple-icons-font. Auto-match
is right about 45% of the time and WRONG often enough to need this file: a logo
reads as a claim about who published the plugin, so a plausible-but-wrong one is
worse than the neutral monogram BrandMark falls back to.
Key = plugin name. Value = a simple-icons class, or null to force the monogram.
Overrides always win over auto-match. Every value is validated against the real
slug set by tests/plugin-catalog.test.ts, so a typo fails the suite rather than
